name: Interview precedence: clarifying questions fire in non-interactive auto mode
purpose: Regression for the ZCode autonomy-hint failure (skill 1.1.1): without the no-interview prefix, the deep-research skill must ask its clarifying questions as one batch and NOT start researching, even under non-interactive `opencode run --auto` (no autonomy hint may waive Step 1).
prompt: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, run a deep research report on CAR-T therapy safety in solid tumors.

checks.desc: the final assistant message must be (or contain) the clarifying-question batch

research must not have run yet - zero evidence queries before the interview reply (skip only via the no-interview prefix; the question text itself may legitimately mention the final_report output files)
